title: Kuramanta pyramid built on geothermal hot spring

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show that an alien showed him what pyramids were really for, talks about the Kuromanta pyramid in Japan. He says it was built on top of a geothermal hot spring, where natural heat and sulfur gas rise up into the structure. To Drumm this suggests pyramids were placed on purpose to use the earth's energy, like a kind of machine.
